wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 09-007 aggregates the pickup side-effect functions (giveBody, giveArmor, giveCard, givePower, touchSpecialThing, set/get/clearPickupContext) and the per-tic powerup functions (tickPowerups, computeFixedColormap, computePalette) into a single src/vanilla re-export facade for P_TouchSpecialThing + the powerup ticker. The read-only src/player/pickups.ts and powerups.ts already implement vanilla p_inter.c / p_user.c semantics; pure barrel + frozen manifest, no source modification.
